purpose: Education loan for regular full-time professional/technical recognized courses approved by Government in India or abroad; includes listed professional/technical courses and higher doctoral studies.
income_limit: Annual family income from all sources <= ₹5,00,000 (current general loan ceiling)
repayment_period: Up to 12 years where repayment has not started; up to 10 years where loan disbursed and repayment started
moratorium: Course period + 1 year where repayment has not started; up to 6 months where loan disbursed and repayment started
channel_partner_types: Current scheme page: SCAs/CAs; current ELS application form states submission through State Channelizing Agency only
education_requirement: Regular full-time professional/technical recognized course; institution recognition/affiliation required; specific courses listed by NSFDC; higher doctoral studies recognized institutions
required_documents: Caste certificate; income certificate; application/personal/academic/course details; passport/visa details for study abroad where applicable; certified study expenses; other channel checklist
verification_authority: Authorized SCA/CA; current ELS form routed through SCA
notes: Maximum is ₹40 lakh or 90% of course fee, whichever is less. Repayment frequency is not specified on current scheme page.
